1879052912.name: Cry of the Wizards
1879052912.desc: Call upon a powerful song to blast your enemies with an area-of-effect of light that will slow the creatures who are hit by it.

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

1879109616.name: Writ of Fire
1879109616.desc:
Stacking fire damage-over-time.

May be applied up to three times, increasing the Writ's tier.

+20% damage per tier increase.

1879112560.name: Improved Feint Attack
1879112560.desc: A quick feint attack misdirects your foe, briefly allowing your next attack to act as though you are attacking from stealth.

1879134320.name: Bursting Root
1879134320.desc: A thick trunk of vegetable matter explodes from the ground and stuns its target, initiating a Fellowship Maneouvre.

1879157616.name: Pinpoint Shot
1879157616.desc: A bow shot with a high critical chance and payout.

1879173360.name: Yule Festival Snow Pony
1879173360.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879191792.name: Protector
1879191792.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Protector.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879198320.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Blackpaw-bear)
1879198320.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879208432.name: Red-clad Horse of the Gap
1879208432.desc: A horse bearing the emblem of the sun in red barding.

1879214576.name: Safeguard
1879214576.desc: A quick strike, which damages the enemy and heals you over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879239408.name: Quick Stop
1879239408.desc: Command your war-steed to quickly stop at the cost of losing all of your Fury. This skill can be used at any speed, but it's most effective at high speeds or when you want to quickly change directions. You may also double-tap the back key to quickly stop.

1879240816.name: a mounted melee attack
1879240816.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a one-handed weapon with a shield.

1879248368.name: Noble Arrow - Light
1879248368.desc: The Noble Arrow of Light, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879250032.name: Driving Slash
1879250032.desc: Using a violent slash against the target you attempt to seriously injure your foe.

1879270512.name: Barrage of Light
1879270512.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879274096.name: Snap Shot - Javelin of Deadly Force
1879274096.desc: With preparation, some Wardens can throw their Javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.\n\nFor every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

1879303920.name: Black Huorn with Honeycomb
1879303920.desc: Summons a black Huorn with a Honeycomb to brighten your day.

1879315056.name: Green-beak Cave-claw
1879315056.desc: Summons a green-beak cave-claw to help you search for riches!

1879335792.name: Soaring Bird Kite
1879335792.desc: Brings out a soaring bird kite for you to fly in the wind.

1879418736.name: Simple Carrying Torch
1879418736.desc: Carry around a simple torch to light your way.

1879428080.name: Momentous Hit
1879428080.desc: Most warriors would say attempting a fist fight on horseback is ill-advised. The Brawler would disagree.

procEffects.description: When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a modest Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Parry or Evade then deal damage to your attacker
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a significant Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a powerful Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff

1879449840.name: Grisly Cry (Dual)
1879449840.desc: Your roar causes even the staunchest enemies to run in fear.\n\nIf specialized in the Roar, fear will apply to all enemies around the target.

1879467248.name: Intimidating Challenge
1879467248.desc: Most enemies would rather flee than face your challenge.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879491056.name: Golden Drakeling
1879491056.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879495152.name: Unlabeled Firework
1879495152.desc: Someone removed the label on this firework, making it impossible to know what explosion to be expecting.

1879497712.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497712.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879500400.name: Gandalf's Aid
1879500400.desc: Call upon Gandlaf to bolster your Hope in the face of overwhelming despair.\n\nTo use this skill, you must be near Gandalf.

1879503600.name: Black Cobra
1879503600.desc: Summons a dangerous black cobra to accompany you on your adventures.

1879507824.name: Hide in Plain Sight
1879507824.desc: Disappear from before the enemy's eyes.\n\nBriefly improves Stealth. Using this skill will not break Stealth.

conditionalEffects.description: Hide in Plain Sight removes some Poison, Disease, Fear and Wound effects from the Burglar.

1879521392.name: Emerald Slime
1879521392.desc: Summons an emerald slime to accompany you on your travels.
